newsitem.title: CHINA: China firm to invest $60 mln in oil facilities.
newsitem.headline: China firm to invest $60 mln in oil facilities.

text.p: The Shenzhen Energy Investment Corp has started to build oil facilities in the southwestern port city of Qinzhou in Guangxi with total investment of 500 million yuan ($60 million), a company official said on Tuesday.
"The project has already started," the official said by telephone from the company's headquarters in the southern city of Shenzhen.
The company owns 67 percent of shares in Shenzhen Energy Investment Co Ltd, which has a 30 percent share of the total investment in the project, he said.
The facilities would include a 30,000-tonne wharf to handle oil and gas, a 50,000-tonne oil storage facility and oil pipelines, he said.
Phase one of the project is expected to be completed in two years, but the whole project would take much longer to complete, the official said. He gave no further details.
